svg.text: Why a genome cannot be anonymized: long-range familial re-identification

svg.text: Even with your name stripped, sharing IBD segments with a distant 3rd cousin in a public database narrows identity to a few people

svg.text: • A genome is a familial identifier: uploading your DNA automatically reveals relatives who never consented.

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Controlled-access enclaves (dbGaP, UK Biobank, All of Us) and federated analysis protect raw genotypes far better than 'de-identification'.

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Legal protections (e.g. GINA in the US) cover health insurance & employment — NOT life, disability, or long-term-care insurance.
